process_area.title: DG Transport, Carrier & Ecommerce Shipping Compliance

value_stream.name: Dangerous Goods (DG) & Hazardous Materials Transport, Ecommerce & Regulatory Compliance

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, Logistics/Freight (links to VS-06/VS-110), Procurement (links to VS-34), HSE (links to VS-24), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Insurance (links to VS-26), Vendor Mgmt (links to VS-03)
fields.Trigger: Carrier sourcing (links to VS-110); DG carrier need; carrier performance review

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics define DG carrier qualification criteria" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documentation obligations, incident notification, sub-contracting rules" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-monitor of "monitor compliance/incidents/documentation quality, conduct periodic…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-572 (ensure controlled execution — DG Transport, Carrier & Ecommerce Shipping Compliance (PA-114.2).)
- operational: approved-list gating; operational: legal-reviewed DG terms
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unauthorized-carrier risk**: Non-DG-authorized carrier ships DG illegally; mitigated by approved-list gating
- **Liability-gap risk**: Carrier contract doesn't allocate DG liability; mitigated by legal-reviewed DG terms
System Touchpoints: - Carrier contracting (links to VS-110); procurement (links to VS-34); legal (links to VS-100.3); insurance (links to VS-26); carrier scorecard (links to VS-67/VS-110); HSE (links to VS-24)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Logistics define DG carrier qualification criteria: modal DG authorization (MARINA/Coast Guard sea, CAB air, LTFRB/DOTr road hazmat permit links to W3607), DG driver training/cert (W3597), DG equipment (placards, spill kits, PPE), DG insurance (links to VS-26), incident history, and capacity for BuildRight's DG classes

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Logistics/Procurement qualify and contract DG carriers: due diligence, DG capability assessment, contract terms (DG scope, liability, insurance, documentation obligations, incident notification, sub-contracting rules), rate/surcharges (DG premium), and the DG service-level agreement; integrate to the carrier scorecard (links to VS-110/VS-67)
steps.r: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer / Logistics / Procurement / Legal

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Logistics manage DG carrier performance: monitor compliance/incidents/documentation quality, conduct periodic re-qualification, manage the approved DG carrier list, and remove/replace non-compliant carriers; report DG carrier performance to governance (W3608)

fields.Participants: DG Shipper (certified W3597), Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110), DC Operations (links to VS-04), Ecommerce (links to VS-10), Import (links to VS-02.2), DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, Carrier
fields.Volume: All DG shipments (subset of ~6.5K receipts/month (~72K/year), ~5K replenishment orders/month, ~42.9K ecommerce orders/month)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics prepare the DG transport documentation per shipment" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "DG Shipper/Logistics generate the load/vehicle manifest, placarding plan" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reject outside tolerance of "DG Shipper/Logistics retain the DG transport documents" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-572 (ensure controlled execution — DG Transport, Carrier & Ecommerce Shipping Compliance (PA-114.2).)
- operational: certified shipper and verification; operational: segregation check
Pain Points / Risks: - **Documentation-error risk**: Wrong/missing DG declaration causes carrier refusal, detention, or incident; mitigated by certified shipper and verification
- **Segregation-error risk**: Incompatible DG co-loaded causes reaction; mitigated by segregation check
System Touchpoints: - DG documentation system; hazmat master (links to W3594/VS-29); transport/TMS (links to VS-110); records (links to VS-88/W3600); ecommerce (links to VS-10); analytics (links to W3608)

steps.activity: DG Shipper/Logistics prepare the DG transport documentation per shipment: Shipper's Declaration for Dangerous Goods (IATA air), DG manifest/multimodal DG form (IMDG sea), transport document (ADR road), the consignment detail (UN number, proper shipping name, class, packing group, quantity, packing instruction), and emergency-response telephone/reference; verify classification (W3594) and packaging/marking (W3598)

DG Shipper/Logistics generate the load/vehicle manifest, placarding plan (placards per transport unit per class), segregation/compatibility check (incompatible DG separated), and the carrier handoff with documentation; ensure the driver/crew is DG-briefed and equipped (spill kit, PPE)

DG Shipper/Logistics retain the DG transport documents (retention per W3600/VS-88), transmit electronic manifests where required, and feed DG shipment data to analytics (W3608) and incident readiness (W3606); manage document exceptions and rejections

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, Logistics/Freight (links to VS-06/VS-110), Import (links to VS-02.2/VS-87), Carrier, HSE (links to VS-24), DG Shipper
fields.Trigger: DG shipment by mode (import ocean, inter-island sea, air, road)

workflows.name: DG Ocean / Air / Road Modal Transport Compliance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics apply the modal transport regulations per shipment" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-route of "route/tunnel restrictions and hazmat-route permits" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track modal compliance KPIs, and feed learnings to classification" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: modal eligibility check; operational: IMDG/IATA stowage rules
Pain Points / Risks: - **Air-prohibited-DG risk**: DG shipped by air that's prohibited/over-limited causes seizure; mitigated by modal eligibility check
- **Stowage-segregation risk**: Wrong stowage on vessel/aircraft causes incident; mitigated by IMDG/IATA stowage rules
System Touchpoints: - TMS/carrier (links to VS-110); import (links to VS-02.2/VS-87); hazmat master (links to W3594); port/airport handling (links to W3607); records (links to W3600); analytics (links to W3608)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Logistics apply the modal transport regulations per shipment: IMDG Code for sea (import ocean links to VS-02.2, inter-island domestic sea), IATA DGR for air, ADR/DOT/LTFRB for road; verify modal-specific packing instructions, quantity limits, and prohibitions (some DG prohibited by air, e.g., certain flammables/lithium-battery limits)
steps.r: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer / DG Shipper / Logistics

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Logistics ensure modal carrier/terminal compliance: sea-terminal DG acceptance and stowage segregation, air-carrier operator variations and acceptance, road route/tunnel restrictions and hazmat-route permits; coordinate port/airport handling (W3607)

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer manage modal-specific incidents and regulatory engagement (links to W3606/W3596), track modal compliance KPIs, and feed learnings to classification (W3594) and carrier management (W3601); report modal compliance to governance (W3608)

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, Ecommerce (links to VS-10), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Logistics/Last-Mile (links to VS-06.3/VS-56/VS-110), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Customer Service (links to VS-13), Master Data (links to VS-29)
fields.Trigger: Ecommerce listing (links to VS-10); DG SKU setup; carrier/channel change
fields.Volume: DG-intensive ecommerce SKUs (~subset of 35K catalog online)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-flag of "flag on the hazmat master" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Ecommerce manage DG ecommerce packaging/marking" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-572 (ensure controlled execution — DG Transport, Carrier & Ecommerce Shipping Compliance (PA-114.2).)
- operational: ship-eligibility enforcement; operational: channel rule mapping
Pain Points / Risks: - **Ineligible-shipment risk**: DG ecommerce order placed that can't ship causes cancel/refund and customer dissatisfaction; mitigated by ship-eligibility enforcement
- **Channel-policy-breach risk**: Marketplace DG policy breach causes listing takedown/account risk; mitigated by channel rule mapping
System Touchpoints: - Ecommerce storefront/order-routing (links to VS-10/VS-60); marketplace channels (links to VS-65/VS-95); hazmat master (links to W3594/VS-29); last-mile (links to VS-06.3/VS-56); customer service (links to VS-13)

steps.a: GM, Digital Commerce Inc. / VP Legal
steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Ecommerce determine DG ship-eligibility per SKU/channel: which DG SKUs can ship ecommerce, by which carrier/mode (last-mile road, inter-island sea, air-prohibited), under limited-quantity/excepted-quantity thresholds, and the channel rules (own site links to VS-10, marketplaces links to VS-65/VS-95 each have DG policies); set the ecommerce ship-eligibility flag on the hazmat master (W3594)

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Ecommerce enforce ship-eligibility at the storefront and order-routing: block/flag DG-in-cart, restrict by ship-to region (inter-island, NCR-only, pickup-only for high-hazard), apply the DG-capable fulfillment-source filter (links to VS-60 routing), and present the customer with DG handling/terms where required

steps.a: GM, Digital Commerce Inc. / VP Legal
steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Ecommerce manage DG ecommerce packaging/marking (W3598), documentation (W3602), last-mile carrier selection (W3605), and customer communication (links to VS-13) for DG shipments; monitor DG ecommerce compliance and adjust rules on carrier/regulatory change (W3596); report to governance (W3608)

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, Last-Mile/3PL (links to VS-06.3/VS-56), Ecommerce (links to VS-10), DC/Dark-Store (links to VS-04/VS-93), HSE (links to VS-24), DG Shipper, 3PL Carrier
fields.Trigger: Ecommerce/B2B DG last-mile shipment (links to VS-06.3/VS-56)
fields.Volume: DG last-mile shipments (subset of ~42.9K ecommerce orders/month + contractor deliveries)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Last-Mile qualify and route DG last-mile shipments" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-route of "DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/3PL execute DG last-mile delivery" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report to governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-572 (ensure controlled execution — DG Transport, Carrier & Ecommerce Shipping Compliance (PA-114.2).)
- operational: carrier development and ship-eligibility rules (W3604); operational: handoff briefing and product info
Pain Points / Risks: - **No-capable-carrier risk**: No DG last-mile carrier for a lane/region blocks ecommerce; mitigated by carrier development and ship-eligibility rules (W3604)
- **Unsafe-handoff risk**: Customer receives DG without safe-handling info; mitigated by handoff briefing and product info
System Touchpoints: - Order routing (links to VS-60); last-mile/3PL (links to VS-06.3/VS-56); hazmat master (links to W3594); documentation (links to W3602); 3PL scorecard (links to VS-56.2/VS-67); HSE (links to VS-24)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Last-Mile qualify and route DG last-mile shipments to DG-capable 3PLs/carriers (W3601): apply the DG-carrier filter to order routing (links to VS-60), verify last-mile DG documentation (W3602) and packaging/marking (W3598), and ensure the 3PL driver/crew is DG-trained (W3597) and equipped

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/3PL execute DG last-mile delivery: vehicle placarding, route compliance (hazmat route restrictions), secure handoff to customer (age/identity verification for restricted items, safe-handling briefing for chemicals), and POD with DG documentation return; manage delivery exceptions and refusals

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Last-Mile manage 3PL DG performance (links to VS-56.2/VS-67), audit DG last-mile compliance, manage the limited courier pool for DG (the model-company reality that hazmat shipping options are limited), and report to governance (W3608)

fields.Owner: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer / Logistics Emergency Response
fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, Logistics (links to VS-06), HSE (links to VS-24/VS-26.2), Carrier, Emergency Responders, Legal (links to VS-100), Insurance (links to VS-26), Compliance (links to VS-22), Communications (links to VS-14.3)
fields.Trigger: DG transport incident (spill, leak, fire, accident, exposure)

workflows.name: DG Transport Incident, Spill & Emergency Response

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics respond to the DG transport incident" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "document the incident" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-572 (ensure controlled execution — DG Transport, Carrier & Ecommerce Shipping Compliance (PA-114.2).)
- operational: 24/7 notification and emergency-response plan; operational: notification protocol and timeline
Pain Points / Risks: - **Slow-response risk**: Delayed incident response worsens harm and liability; mitigated by 24/7 notification and emergency-response plan
- **Regulatory-notification-miss risk**: Failure to notify regulators attracts penalty; mitigated by notification protocol and timeline
System Touchpoints: - SDS/emergency-response (links to W3595); HSE/incident (links to VS-24/VS-26.2); legal (links to VS-100); insurance (links to VS-26); communications (links to VS-14.3); records (links to W3613/W3600)

steps.activity: Carrier/Logistics respond to the DG transport incident: immediate safety (isolate, evacuate, PPE), first response per the SDS (W3595) and emergency-response guide, notification to BuildRight DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer and HSE, and engagement of emergency responders (fire/BFP, medical, hazmat contractor); secure the scene and prevent spread

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE manage the response and notification: regulatory notification (DENR-EMB for environmental release, DOLE for worker, MARINA/Coast Guard/CAB/LTFRB for transport, LGU), carrier/3PL coordination, containment/clean-up/remediation (hazmat contractor), and customer/public communication (links to VS-14.3); engage legal (links to VS-100) and insurance (links to VS-26)
steps.r: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer / HSE / Legal / Insurance

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE conduct incident investigation and root-cause (links to VS-24/VS-21), document the incident (W3613/W3600), manage claims/insurance recovery (links to VS-26/VS-90), and feed corrective action to classification/packaging/training/carrier (W3594/W3598/W3597/W3601); report to governance (W3616) and risk (links to VS-21.2)

fields.Frequency: Per DG port/airport movement + permit cycle
fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, Import (links to VS-02.2/VS-87), Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110), Broker, Carrier, Port/Airport Authority, HSE (links to VS-24)
fields.Trigger: DG import/export (links to VS-87); DG through port/airport; special-permit DG
fields.Volume: DG import/export and inter-island port/airport movements

workflows.name: DG Transport Permit, Escort & Port / Airport Handling

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-import of "Import manage DG port/airport handling" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "Logistics manage DG port/airport documentation and handoff" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-572 (ensure controlled execution — DG Transport, Carrier & Ecommerce Shipping Compliance (PA-114.2).)
- operational: pre-advise and DG-savvy broker; operational: permit-lifecycle management
Pain Points / Risks: - **Port-detention risk**: DG mishandled at port causes detention/demurrage; mitigated by pre-advise and DG-savvy broker
- **Permit-lapse risk**: Movement without valid permit causes seizure; mitigated by permit-lifecycle management
System Touchpoints: - Import/customs (links to VS-02.2/VS-87); port/terminal; transport documentation (links to W3602); permits (links to W3599/VS-22); demurrage (links to VS-02.2); analytics (links to W3608)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Import manage DG port/airport handling: pre-advise the port/airport authority and terminal of DG cargo, secure DG berth/slot/stowage, arrange DG handling/escort (some DG requires escort/special handling), and align to terminal DG rules and cut-offs; coordinate with broker (links to VS-02.2)

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Import secure special DG permits where required: special-permit DG (high-hazard), DENR import permit for regulated chemicals (links to W3599), MARINA/Coast Guard/CAB transport permits, and escort/police coordination for high-risk DG; manage the permit lifecycle and validity

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Logistics manage DG port/airport documentation and handoff (links to W3602), monitor dwell-time/demurrage for DG (links to VS-02.2/W249), and resolve DG-specific port/airport issues; report DG port/airport performance to governance (W3608)

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110), BI (links to VS-28.1), Audit (links to VS-21), Ecommerce (links to VS-10), HSE (links to VS-24), ExCo (links to VS-33.2)

workflows.name: DG Transport Audit, Carrier Performance & Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "documentation accuracy, incidents/near-misses" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "Logistics produce the DG transport dashboards" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-post of "posture, carrier performance, incidents, and risk to governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-572 (ensure controlled execution — DG Transport, Carrier & Ecommerce Shipping Compliance (PA-114.2).)
- operational: instrumentation and integration; operational: leading-indicator metrics
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data-fragmentation risk**: DG transport data scattered across systems; mitigated by instrumentation and integration
- **Reactive-management risk**: Issues found only after incident; mitigated by leading-indicator metrics
System Touchpoints: - BI/dashboards (links to VS-28.1); carrier scorecard (links to VS-67/VS-110); incidents (links to W3606); governance (links to VS-36); risk (links to VS-21.2); analytics (links to W3616)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/BI define and instrument DG transport metrics: DG shipment volume by mode/class, carrier compliance %, documentation accuracy, incidents/near-misses (W3606), carrier refusals/detentions, ecommerce ship-eligibility coverage (W3604), and cost (DG premium, demurrage, remediation)

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Logistics produce the DG transport dashboards: carrier scorecard (links to VS-67/VS-110), compliance status, incident trend, cost, and channel (ecommerce) DG coverage; tailored views per audience

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer report DG transport posture, carrier performance, incidents, and risk to governance (W3616), the risk committee (links to VS-21.2/VS-36), and ExCo (links to VS-33.2); drive corrective action and continuous improvement
